description:
Check the dogfood package against this repository's declaration registries through a configured gate rather than the Rust test suite, so test verdicts do not depend on `.jit/*.toml`.

## Background

The contribution and template drift tests in `crates/jit/src/profile/repository_package.rs` compare the package against `.jit/*.toml`. A test here depends on this repository's local policy. A wrong gate-input footprint or exclusion makes a reused gate verdict silently stale, so that check must keep running over this repository. The `repo-validate` command check and the live `dev/archive` layout check are deleted: an edit to either is explicit or visible.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: A configured gate fails when the dogfood package's contributions or templates drift from this repository's `.jit/*.toml` registries, through a dev-only example over the existing test-only drift modules, so no adopter build carries new code.
- [hard] REQ-02: That gate also fails on an invalid gate-input declaration of this repository, by the smallest check that works.
- [hard] REQ-03: The drift tests that read `.jit/*.toml` no longer exist in `profile/repository_package.rs`.
title: Package drift over the registries runs as a gate
